rationale.model_parameters: Use one stable Hawkes-Gamma benchmark kernel with explicit spectral-radius margin and a neutral market-pressure block so oracle, pricing, and sufficient-statistics benchmarks measure throughput and latency under valid dynamics rather than domain failures.
rationale.oracle_solver_probes: Use low-amplitude positive u probes and near-unity z probes to keep transform evaluations in a numerically stable region while still varying workload across invocations.
rationale.pricing_input_ranges: Use bounded spot, strike, maturity, rate, and volatility ranges that remain realistic for vanilla option workloads and reduce CI flakiness from extreme pricing pathologies.
rationale.seed_partition: Use fixed pairwise-distinct seed salts so oracle, pricing, and sufficient-statistics benchmarks remain reproducible while avoiding cross-component random-stream coupling.
